FINAL SUMMARY (post-merge audit). Gerrit change 1763 MERGED as 007734ee7f (PS4, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Worktree audit: clean tree, zero unpushed commits — everything intended for the change landed in it.

Coverage of the four PS1 LLM-Review findings — ALL addressed in PS2-PS4:
1. transient-fault discrimination in _snapshot_in_head: tri-state probe (rev-parse HEAD health check; cat-file rc-124 -> INDETERMINATE); recovery keeps the journal and defers on uncertainty, never reverting a possibly-landed fold. Tests: test_recovery_defers_when_head_probe_is_indeterminate, test_recovery_defers_when_head_is_unresolvable.
2. superseded-journal branch (snapshot gone from disk): test_recovery_discards_journal_when_snapshot_gone_from_disk.
3. incomplete-rollback snapshot retention: test_rollback_retains_snapshot_when_reverse_rename_fails (in-process) + test_recovery_retains_snapshot_when_reverse_rename_fails (cross-process twin, gap found by the PS3 review and fixed in PS4).
4. write_intent-refusal path: test_apply_fold_refuses_to_mutate_when_journal_unwritable.

No follow-up ticket needed for the findings. 16 oracle tests green; 8/8 manual mutants killed (incl. M7 rc-124-misread, M8 inverted retain guard); lint/typecheck/complexity/raw-git gates green. Interim mitigation [compact] trigger="off" removed from the host user config. Ticket closed with all five AC boxes checked.
